title: Avika aaj time pe?
format: Kitty Gang clock timeline on the Gurpurab game: one Gurpurab day told in clock jumps (Prabhat Pheri, Kada Prasad, Langar, Deepmala), late Avika misses every one, then is on time for the 9 PM Housie and wins the Kada Prasad group

experiment.hook: Avika in a breathless panic on the Gurpurab home art, heartbeat and tick at 0 s, mascot ball spinning above, chip '4:30 AM | PRABHAT PHERI' pinned from the first frame, she says 'Pheri nikal gayi? Main aa rahi hoon!'
experiment.variable: the progress counter is a clock, not a score: every cut jumps the time chip forward through the festival day (4:30 AM, 9 AM, 1 PM, 7 PM) and lands on a real game time (9 PM), so the viewer always knows how far the story is from the end, compared with the 'x/4' counters that stalled at 14 to 16% watched
experiment.hypothesis: a running clock across a day the viewer is living right now (Gurpurab morning to night) feels like a story with a destination, not a list: skip under 55% (best 45.2), watched % above 20 (14 to 16 on x/4 counter reels, best 21), at least 1 share or tag from 'jo har jagah late aati hai'

idea: On Gurpurab, late Avika misses the Prabhat Pheri, Megha takes her share of Kada Prasad, Shruti counts her missing at Langar, Zoya films the Deepmala without her, then at 9 PM Avika is on time for once and wins the Kada Prasad group.
beats: hook: 4:30 AM, pheri nikal gayi? / 9 AM: Megha took Avika's prasad / 1 PM: Shruti counts, Avika missing / 7 PM: Zoya films diyas, still no Avika / 9 PM: the call on the game / reveal: Kada Prasad group is Avika's / turn: Avika, aaj main time pe thi / button: Aditi, Housie ke liye hamesha
logline: On Gurpurab, Avika is late for everything all day, then shows up on time for the 9 PM Housie and wins.
game: every clock jump the gang is there and Avika is not, until the one time she is early
caption: Sab jagah late, Housie pe time pe! Har group mein ek Avika hoti hai, tag karo. Gurpurab ki lakh lakh vadhaiyan! Aaj ki {theme} Housie mein milte hain.

lines.text: Pheri nikal gayi? Main aa rahi hoon!
lines.say: फेरी निकल गई? मैं आ रही हूँ!

lines.text: Avika ka prasad bhi maine le liya!
lines.say: अविका का प्रसाद भी मैंने ले लिया!

lines.text: Diye jal gaye. Avika abhi raste mein!
lines.say: दिये जल गए। अविका अभी रास्ते में!

lines.text: Dekha? Aaj main time pe thi!
lines.say: देखा? आज मैं टाइम पे थी!
